The `NameError` crash under `MODEL_PROVIDER=gemini` and the test gap have been addressed:

### 1. Fix NameError and Provider Identification
- In [app/main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py#L21), imported `FakeProvider` and `logging`.
- In [witnessed/providers.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/witnessed/providers.py#L52-L64), updated `ReadingProvider` protocol, `FakeProvider`, and `GeminiProvider` to expose a `name` attribute (`"fake"` and `"gemini"` respectively) and track `last_model` representing the actual model ID targeted or used.
- In [app/main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py#L571-L577) and [app/main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py#L738-L745), replaced brittle `isinstance` checks with provider-exposed metadata (`provider.last_model`, `provider.model`, or `provider.name`), with safe fallbacks.
- Guarded `_get_client()` in [witnessed/providers.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/witnessed/providers.py#L272-L276) so any client initialization error returns `None` instead of raising an uncaught exception.

### 2. Make `upload_photo` and `submit` Robust
- In [app/main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py#L555-L570), wrapped provider retrieval and `provider.read(...)` in `upload_photo` in `try/except`. Any exception is logged with `logger.exception`, setting `reading = None` and `status = "unchecked"` while returning HTTP 200 rather than a 500 error.
- In [app/main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py#L756-L766), wrapped `summarize(findings, provider)` in `submit_capture` with `try/except`. Provider errors during submission are logged and fallback to `ai_summary_dict = None`, allowing package sealing and claim submission to succeed without 500s.
- In [witnessed/summary.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/witnessed/summary.py#L86-L108), wrapped `provider.summarize(...)` calls in `try/except` with logging to ensure provider summary failures return `None` cleanly.
- In [app/main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py#L916-L922), guarded summary generation on the claim report page.

### 3. Close the Test Gap
- Added [tests/test_live_paths.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_live_paths.py) with `StubLiveProvider`, a non-fake provider stub matching `GeminiProvider`'s interface.
- Patched provider retrieval via `app.main.get_provider` and verified the full end-to-end flow (**create claim → four uploads → submit → report → package → verify → tamper**) across:
  - (a) Valid readings (`test_live_path_valid_readings`)
  - (b) `None` readings for some slots resulting in `unchecked` status (`test_live_path_none_readings_become_unchecked`)
  - (c) Exceptions raised inside `read` resulting in `unchecked` status and HTTP 200 rather than 500 (`test_live_path_provider_exception_in_read_becomes_unchecked_no_500` and `test_live_path_all_slots_raise_inside_read`)
  - (d) Exceptions raised inside `summarize` during submission (`test_live_path_provider_exception_in_summarize_never_500`)
